subject: GreenSky: Invoice delivery / portal JSON schema & PO stamping
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@greenskylogistics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0000
Subject: Vendor onboarding - invoice delivery options and schema request

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're getting GreenSky's AP team set up to send invoices into Redwood for the upcoming integration. Two quick asks as we prepare: 1) do you require that we use the portal (preferred) or is email (smtp with PDF/CSV) acceptable as a long-term option? 2) can you share a machine-readable example schema (JSON) for line items + PO linking so our engineering team can map their ERP export?

Some constraints on our side: we export multi-line invoices in JSON and can produce a compact CSV for low-volume suppliers. We also need to know how PO stamping should be handled when a single invoice references more than one PO.

Appreciate any samples or checklist you can share.

Best,
Liam

GreenSky Logistics

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.inference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@greenskylogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 12:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding - invoice delivery options and schema request

Hi Liam — thanks, and great to see GreenSky moving fast. Short answers up front: portal-first is our recommended default (better validation, idempotency, and subject-token tracking). Email/SFTP is supported as a backstop but requires stricter subject conventions and we can only accept compact attachments (CSV / JSONL) for automated processing. PDFs are processed but require human review and are slower.

I've attached a small JSON example and a compact CSV sample you can use for the email fallback. Key implementation notes:
- Preferred: POST to the portal API with the JSON payload (see greensky_invoice_sample.json) -> immediate ack + invoice_id
- Email fallback: subject token required (format: Redwood-INVOICE-<vendor_id>-<timestamp>) and attachment must be CSV with the compact schema below; we will ingest multi-po invoices if the line_items array includes a "po_number" per line
- PO stamping: we recommend you include a top-level "purchase_orders" array AND a "po_number" per line item. For reconciliation, the portal uses the per-line PO link; if multiple POs are present we create a parent invoice with child allocations to each PO.

I'll paste the compact CSV schema we expect for the email path below and the JSON example is attached. If you want, Marissa can walk your engineers through sample exports this week.

Compact CSV columns we accept (email fallback):
vendor_id,invoice_number,invoice_date,currency,amount,line_number,description,quantity,unit_price,po_number,tax_amount

Sample rules:
- Dates must be ISO (YYYY-MM-DD).
- Amounts in decimal with dot.
- If multiple POs: repeat lines with different po_number values.
- Subject token is used to tie retries and dedupe.

Let us know if you want a quick screen share.

Thanks,
Diego
Head of Procurement Integrations
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: greensky_invoice_sample.json (attached), greensky_invoice_compact.csv (attached)

Diego — this is perfect, thanks. Two follow-ups from our AP lead:
1) For multi-PO invoices: will Redwood allocate payment automatically to each PO, or do we need to send separate invoices per PO to preserve downstream remittance matching?
2) Subject token: our mail gateway strips headers; can we instead include the token in the filename (e.g., Redwood-INVOICE-12345-20270214.csv)?

If filename token is acceptable we'll adjust our email template to include it. Also looping in accounts-payable@greenskylogistics.com to confirm.

Liam

Subject: Fwd: GreenSky: Invoice delivery / portal JSON schema & PO stamping

Marissa / Vanessa — looping you in to confirm a couple of operational decisions for GreenSky:

- Multi-PO handling: I proposed we accept a single invoice with per-line po_number and create allocations per PO. Confirm if ops team is comfortable auto-allocating payments (we'll surface allocations in the invoice detail view). If not, we should require separate invoices per PO.
- Filename token: customer notes that their gateway strips subject headers. Can we support token extraction from filename (pattern: Redwood-INVOICE-<vendor_id>-<timestamp>.csv) as a fallback for dedupe? I'd like to enable filename token parsing for partners designated as "email-backstop" only to reduce accidental collisions.

If you agree, I'll update the onboarding doc and the AP onboarding form (link below) and give them an engineer pairing session next week.

Thanks,
Diego
